captions.text: Sri Lanka passed a data protection law in 2022. So is it in force?
The regulator, the Data Protection Authority, has existed since 2023.
The duties on businesses start on the first of January 2027.
Have a lawful reason. Tell people what you collect. Keep it safe. Report leaks.
Your rights to see, correct or delete your file? Written into the Act. But no start date.
Same for the marketing-message rules, and the fines.
You may have read it all started on 18 March 2025. That date was cancelled four days before it arrived.
We track every section at datasavi.lk.
